from pathlib import Path
pdir=base/'programs'; pdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    h = r1 - r0 + 1
    w = c1 - c0 + 1
    source = [[grid[rows - 1 - (r0 + i)][cols - 1 - (c0 + j)] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    return [row[::-1] for row in source[::-1]]
'''
file=pdir/f'{task}.py'; file.write_text(program)
print(file, file.read_text())
